themes_detail.label: Graffiti Surge THIS WEEK
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints spiked to 23 THIS WEEK—a 557% jump from the 3.5-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.09)—suggesting a sudden, concentrated vandalism campaign or coordinated tagging in Flatbush/PLG.
evidence: 23 graffiti complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.5 weekly baseline (557% spike)
Z-score of 6.09 indicates statistically extreme deviation
Spike began this week, not a gradual trend
reporting_angles: Map the graffiti hotspots this week—are they clustered in one neighborhood or dispersed across Flatbush/PLG?
Interview NYPD and Parks Dept on whether this is organized crew activity or copycat tagging

themes_detail.label: Street Sweeping Failures THIS WEEK
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints jumped to 7 THIS WEEK—an 833% increase from the 0.8-complaint weekly average (z-score: 5.74)—indicating a sudden collapse in sanitation pickup or schedule disruption.
evidence: 7 street sweeping complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly baseline (833% spike)
Z-score of 5.74 indicates highly anomalous event
Timing suggests infrastructure or staffing disruption this week
reporting_angles: Contact Sanitation Dept: was there a route cancellation, equipment failure, or weather disruption this week?
Verify which streets are affected and whether complaints cluster in specific neighborhoods

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dogs THIS WEEK
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints reached 3 THIS WEEK—a 700% spike from the 0.4-complaint weekly average (z-score: 5.42)—an unusual enforcement or behavioral shift in a short timeframe.
evidence: 3 unleashed dog complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly baseline (700% spike)
Z-score of 5.42 indicates statistically significant deviation
Pattern emerged only this week; extremely rare complaint type overall
reporting_angles: Identify specific parks or blocks where unleashed dogs are congregating
Interview dog owners and residents on whether enforcement or seasonal behavior has changed

themes_detail.label: Asbestos Detection Spike (3 weeks ago)
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints surged to 11 three weeks ago—a 1367% spike from the 0.8-complaint baseline (z-score: 9.41, highest severity)—indicating possible building demolitions, renovations, or contamination discoveries.
evidence: 11 asbestos complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.8 weekly baseline (1367% spike)
Z-score of 9.41 is the highest statistical anomaly in the dataset
332 alteration/demolition permits filed in last 90 days; asbestos spike may reflect discovery during renovations
reporting_angles: Cross-reference asbestos complaints with DOB demolition and alteration permits filed 3–4 weeks ago
Investigate which buildings triggered asbestos complaints and whether proper notification and abatement occurred
Interview residents near affected sites on health impacts or evacuation

themes_detail.label: Food Poisoning Reports (last week)
themes_detail.summary: Food poisoning complaints reached 4 last week—a 967% spike from the 0.4-complaint baseline (z-score: 5.21)—raising public health concerns about restaurant sanitation or a specific outbreak.
evidence: 4 food poisoning complaints last week vs. 0.4 weekly baseline (967% spike)
Z-score of 5.21 indicates severe statistical anomaly
Top 311 complaint (unsanitary conditions, 680 total) also elevated, suggesting potential food safety pattern
reporting_angles: Identify which restaurants or food venues are linked to the four complaints
Contact NYC Health Dept on whether they've opened investigations and issued violations
Interview affected residents on symptoms and timeline to determine if complaints reflect single source or multiple venues
